strategies.hypothesis: Holding the top-N (1-3) of 20 daily-reset 2x/3x leveraged ETFs by trailing 1/3/6-month (optionally last-week-skipped or volatility-adjusted) momentum, at most one fund per underlying index, equal weight with requested gross = margin capped to the FINRA leveraged-ETF maintenance limit (3x book <= ~1.29x), rebalanced on the first session of each week and moved to cash/IEF/TMF when SPY is below its 200-day SMA, earns a positive after-cost Sharpe that a random re-timing of the same holdings does not. SURVIVORSHIP CAVEAT: only leveraged ETFs that still exist today are in the universe (many closed after crashes; NUGT/ERX cut leverage in 2020), so the backtest is biased UPWARD.
